title: Cat Rescues a Collapsing Tofu Tower at 3:30 AM
caption:
A tofu tower collapses at 3:30 AM... until a cat steps in
A gloved hand stacks tofu into a tall pyramid and tops it with century egg, then the whole thing crashes down - and a cat paw swoops in to catch every cube on a plate.
Best watched on loop: the slow-motion chaos melts into a calm, sunlit breakfast - pure wind-down energy.
Would you trust your cat to catch dinner?
Save this for your next 3 AM scroll and follow for more tiny kitchen dramas.
